Thank you for taking an interest in helping rebuild the Kingdom of Jude.
Of course. Tell me about it. If I can help, I'd like to...
strings.그러죠. 아실지 모르겠지만, 쥬드 왕국에서는 이스트랜드 내 여러 세력들과: Certainly. You may know that Jude seeks close cooperation with the various powers of Eastland.
strings.사실 따지고 보면 타르타로스의 일부는 쥬드 왕국의 영토입니다만, 황폐화된: Technically, part of Tartaros belongs to Jude. But reluctance to develop the desolate Amaloon Desert led to this area being abandoned as well.
strings.그런 지역을 샤이닉 님이 \"여기 내가 맘대로 한다? 알았지?\" 그런: Then Shynic said something like, 'I'll do whatever I want here, all right?' and began developing it immediately.
I see. That sounds like her...
strings.그러다가 쥬드 왕국이 모스 왕국에 습격을 받았고, 재건 중에 많은 도움이: Then the Kingdom of Moss attacked Jude. Its reconstruction now requires considerable help.
strings.다른 곳과는 어떤지 잘 모르겠습니다만, 쥬드 왕국에서 저희 타르타로스와: I don't know about its relations elsewhere, but Jude is eager to cooperate closely with Tartaros.
strings.마침 동부 국경지대 페스토 영지의 바질 영주가 영애인 비올렛 님을 직접: Lord Basil of the Pesto estate on the eastern border is taking it so seriously that he sent his own daughter, Lady Violet.
strings.전 쥬드 왕국과 계속해서 관계를 유지해야 한다고 생각해 샤이닉 님께 말씀: I keep telling Shynic that we should maintain relations with Jude, but...
strings.역시 재미가 없다거나 그런 건가요?: She thinks it's boring, I suppose?
Yes. She's been saying nothing is any fun lately...
strings.그래서 말인데, 재미있는 물건이 필요할 것 같습니다. 재미있는 물건이 있: So I think we'll need some amusing objects. Perhaps something interesting would change her mind?
Someone who only acts if it's fun...
I've identified a few entertaining items. I'd be grateful if you could fetch them. If you can't, who knows what Shynic might do?
Melvic, please don't say that, even as a joke...
Once you have them, please bring them to Layer. Thank you.
strings.이야기는 들었어. 샤이닉 씨가 재미있어 하는 물건을 가져오면 맡아달라고…: I've heard. I'm to look after whatever entertaining things you bring for Shynic...
strings.그럼 내가 창고에 잘 넣어두지. 그런데 왜 날 빤히 바라보고 있지?: Then I'll put them safely in storage. But why are you staring at me?
I can sense your strength. You look like an exceptional fighter.
You caught me? Hahaha. I'm just a retired old man.
strings.아, 내 소개가 늦었군. 난 레이어, 한 때는 사막을 돌아다니던 용병이었: Ah, I haven't introduced myself. I'm Layer. I used to be a mercenary roaming the desert.
Now I run the warehouse in Tartaros at Shynic's request.
strings.그런 자기도 대단해 보이는군. 샤이닉 씨가 부탁한 이런 물건을 잘도 구해: You look impressive yourself, bringing back all these things for her.
strings.그런데 이런 물건을 왜 구해온 거지?: Why were you collecting these things, though?
strings.(레이어에게 멜빅이 일을 부탁했다고 이야기한다.): (You tell Layer that Melvic asked you to do it.)
strings.그런 일이 있었군. 멜빅이 하는 일이라면 더 도와야 할 것 같은데…. 이: So that's what happened. If it's Melvic's work, I should help more... Why not secure promises of support from elsewhere, too?
strings.내가 한 때, 바질 영주님께 도움 받은 일이 있어서 조금이나마 은혜를 갚: Lord Basil helped me once. I'd like to repay at least a little of that kindness... Let's see.
strings.옛 생각이 갑자기 나서…. 아, 자기가 루맨에서 왔으면 제릭스를 알고 있: It brought back memories... Ah, if you came from Lumen, you must know Jerix?
strings.네, 물론 알죠. 안하무인에 도도하고 배려없지만, 완벽한 재정관리의 달인: Of course. Arrogant, haughty, and inconsiderate, but a flawless master of finance: Jerix, Lumen's head butler.
strings.부끄러움이 많던 그이의 평가가 그렇게 변했군. 그이한테 가서 내가 보냈다: So that's what people think of him now. He used to be so shy. Tell him I sent you. He'll take care of things.
strings.제릭스 그이가 나한테 좀 섭섭한 감정이 남아있을지도 몰라서 말이야. 하하: He might still feel a little hurt over me. Hahaha.
strings.무슨 이야긴지는 잘 모르겠지만, 이대로 그냥 가면 안 될 것 같은데요?: I don't know the story, but it sounds like I shouldn't go empty-handed.
strings.그럼 뭐라도 하나 들고 선물로 가져가는 게 좋겠군. 뭐가 좋을까?: Then you'd better bring a gift. What would be good...?
Ah, this should do. A big pile of Traveler's Rings.
strings.그것만 구해다 주면 되나요?: That's all I need to bring?
strings.그래. 그러면 알아서 잘 해줄 거야. 쥬드 왕국의 재건이 엄청나게 빨리: Yes. He'll handle the rest. Enough to speed Jude's reconstruction along considerably.
strings.떠난다고 들었는데, 아직 안떠났나?: I heard you were leaving. Haven't you gone yet?
I went to Tartaros, but something came up, so I'm back briefly.
Yes. Layer had a favor to ask.
He sent me to ask for your help.
I'll pretend I didn't hear that.
strings.레이어 씨가 쥬드 왕국 남부 영지 바질 영주님께 은혜를 갚고 싶으시다면서: Layer wants to repay Lord Basil of Jude's southern territory for his kindness. He thought asking you would do the trick...
strings.으아아아악, 그 아이는 대체 이걸로 몇십년을 우려먹는 건지. 반지는 해가: Aaaaah! How many decades is that boy going to milk this?! The rings keep multiplying every year.
Just because I was rejected doesn't mean he can hold it over me...
strings.(분위기가 이상하게 흘러가서 도망갈 준비를 한다. 하지만, 이내 제릭스에: (As the atmosphere takes a strange turn, you prepare to escape. Jerix catches you.)
strings.후우, 어딜 가지?: Sigh. Where do you think you're going?
No helping it. This isn't Layer's fault.
strings.날 스승이라고 하면서 시켜 먹을 건 다 시키는군. 알았으니까 루맨에서 한: He calls me his master, yet makes me do everything. Fine. Lumen will once again pledge support to Tartaros and the Kingdom of Jude.
Tell Melvic I'll increase the aid, so he can stop this! That wretch... How many times is this now?
Hehe. You've brought good news from Lumen.
strings.(제릭스를 찾아가서 일어난 상황을 멜빅에게 설명한다.): (You explain to Melvic what happened during your visit to Jerix.)
Hehe. My true master, as ever.
strings.앞으로 종종 이용해야겠습니다. 안 그래도 많은 도움을 주셨는데, 계속 주: I'll have to make use of this from time to time. He's helped so much already, and if he'll continue, I see no reason to refuse.
strings.(어떻게 보면 샤이닉 님보다 더 하다니까.): (In some ways, he's worse than Shynic.)
strings.후후. 무슨 생각을 골똘히 하십니까?: Hehe. What has you thinking so hard?
Meanwhile, Shynic has promised aid to Jude.
strings.루맨에서도 확답을 받을 때까지 기다린 보람이 있었던 것 같습니다. 가서: It was worth waiting for Lumen's firm commitment. Please give Lady Violet the good news.
strings.멜빅이 직접 전달해주시는 건 어때요?: Why don't you tell her yourself?
strings.저보다는 모험가님께서 해주시는 게 더 좋다고 생각합니다. 아무래도 신을: I think it would be better coming from you, adventurer. A promise from a follower of a god inspires more trust.
strings.예전에 쥬드 왕국을 도와주셨을 때 제대로 감사 인사를 못 드린 것 같아서: I've felt bad that I never properly thanked you for helping Jude before.
I heard you'd arrived in Tartaros. I'm sorry I didn't greet you sooner.
It's all right. I have something to tell you.
strings.(타르타로스와 루맨에서 쥬드 왕국 재건 관련해서 지원을 약속받은 이야기를: (You explain that Tartaros and Lumen have pledged support for Jude's reconstruction.)
strings.샤이닉 님이 요즘 기분이 많이 안 좋으신 것 같아서 어떻게 해야 하나 고: Shynic seemed to be in such a poor mood lately. I was struggling to decide what to do.
You've helped us again. Thank you, once more.
Oh, it wasn't really... How should I put it...?
strings.당장 아버님께 사람을 보내 알려야겠어요. 영웅이신 모험가님께서 이번에도: I must send word to Father immediately. Tell him our heroic adventurer has helped us once again...
strings.정말 많은 분이 도와주셔서 저희 왕국은 복 받은 것 같아요. 안 그래도: Our kingdom is blessed to have so many people helping. The Silvaria Empire in Freios has also offered aid, and we're waiting for it.
strings.네, 고귀한 여제께서 다스리는 나라라고 들었어요. 혹시 모험가님은 여제님: Yes. I hear a noble empress rules there. Have you met her, adventurer?
Not yet. I haven't even been near the empire.
I see. If you visit someday, please tell me all about it.
strings.그리고 언제가 될지 모르지만, 저희 영지에 방문해 주시면 성대한 연회로: And whenever you visit our estate, we'll welcome you with a grand banquet. Thank you, always.
